thread:
yumi: FYI ran a long-context eval on canary and saw VRAM fragmentation spike during background host-moves. peak contiguous free dropped to ~1.5MB while allocator expected ~64MB. saved compact trace + heapmap.

raja: can you paste the allocator tail? suspect scatter-gather copies leaving interleaved freed pages.

yumi: snippet:
```
ALLOC need=64MB got=1.5MB largest_free_run=1572864
COPY slab=0xabc part=0/8 src=GPU0 dst=HOST1
FREE run_len=128KB at=0x7f2000
COPY slab=0xabc part=7/8 completed out-of-order
ALLOC fail -> trigger eviction storm
```

emily: telemetry gap. we only export free_bytes and free_runs_count. propose adding: `largest_free_run_bytes`, `free_run_size_histogram`, and `pinned_run_ratio`. tag by tenant+pool.

nate: mitigation ideas: 1) placement hint API: rebalancer does a quick contiguous-probe before copying large slab and skips targets with insufficient contiguous space. 2) slab-mosaic chunking: split slab into fixed chunks (e.g., 8MB) and move chunks atomically updating a chunk-bitmap descriptor. avoids requiring large contiguous target.

raja: chunk-bitmap is simple conceptually but hot-slab descriptor will be a hotspot. we can namespace descriptors in kvcache and add per-slab-rate limiters. also need clear visibility: eviction should consult bitmap and not assume slab contiguous.

emily: temporary compromise: opportunistic in-place coalesce on host metadata only (merge adjacent free runs if unpinned) to reduce fragmentation quickly without data movement. pair with low-priority background compactor for cold pages.

yumi: agree. also suggest adaptive chunk size: probe for contiguous window, if < required then try chunking with exponential backoff on chunk size. keeps copy count low when possible.

raja: operationally add an alert when canary copy_rate correlates >25% with eviction_rate increase over 5m. ops-bot can create pager if correlated and canary hosts >2.

ops-bot: alert-rule created: `rebalance_copy_eviction_correlation` threshold=0.25 scope=canary hosts.

emily: action items:
- emily -> metrics PR: largest_free_run_bytes, free_run_histogram, pinned_run_ratio (with tenant tag)
- raja -> implement fast contiguous-probe + adaptive chunking prototype behind `probe_and_chunk_v1` flag
- nate -> sketch chunk-bitmap descriptor + kvcache contention mitigation (doc)
- ops -> add correlation alert + dashboards for free-run histogram

yumi: will attach heapmap + trace to RFC follow-up and run synthetic canary pattern (interleave small pins + big frees) after probe lands.

raja: thanks, landing probe today behind flag. we'll monitor histograms during the night run.

yumi: great, thanks all.
